question: [INSTRUCTOR_NAME] 先生の授業を教えて
sql: SELECT C.course_id, C.title FROM Course C JOIN User U ON C.user_id__instructor = U.user_id WHERE U.user_id = '[USER_ID]'

question: [INSTRUCTOR_NAME] 先生の授業はいつですか？
sql: SELECT C.course_id, C.title, S.day_of_week, S.period FROM Course AS C JOIN User AS U ON C.user_id__instructor = U.user_id JOIN Course_Schedule AS S ON C.course_id = S.course_id WHERE U.user_id = '[USER_ID]'

question: [INSTRUCTOR_NAME] 先生の授業の教室はどこですか？
sql: SELECT C.course_id, C.title, R.building_name, R.room_id FROM Course AS C JOIN User AS U ON C.user_id__instructor = U.user_id JOIN Course_Schedule AS S ON C.course_id = S.course_id JOIN Room AS R ON S.room_id = R.room_id WHERE U.user_id = '[USER_ID]'

question: [DAY_OF_WEEK]曜日の[PERIOD]限の授業は何ですか？
sql: SELECT C.course_id, C.title, S.day_of_week, S.period, R.room_id FROM Course C JOIN Course_Schedule S ON C.course_id = S.course_id JOIN Room R ON S.room_id = R.room_id WHERE S.day_of_week = '[DAY_OF_WEEK]' AND S.period = [PERIOD]

question: [ROOM_ID] 教室で行われる授業を教えて
sql: SELECT C.course_id, C.title, S.day_of_week, S.period FROM Course C JOIN Course_Schedule S ON C.course_id = S.course_id WHERE S.room_id = '[ROOM_ID]'
